assessment.nobel_worthiness: Fetal cell-free DNA made prenatal genetic screening substantially less invasive and reshaped clinical diagnostics.
assessment.attribution: The candidate identifies a singular discoverer and a coherent discovery-to-application contribution.
assessment.maturity: The approach is clinically established and its medical significance has been demonstrated over many years.
uncertainties: The supplied evidence does not detail the relative contributions of subsequent assay developers and clinical-validation groups.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology and incretin therapies have produced a major advance in treatment of diabetes and obesity.
assessment.attribution: These proposed laureates represent complementary foundational physiology, molecular characterization, and therapeutic translation.
assessment.maturity: The therapeutic class has extensive clinical use and a durable record of benefit.
uncertainties: The candidate lists four contributors, and the precise boundary between foundational discovery and later drug-development credit requires careful review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: HER2-directed antibody therapy established a decisive molecularly targeted treatment for an important breast-cancer subtype.
assessment.attribution: The listed trio plausibly spans identification of the target, clinical definition of its significance, and therapeutic antibody development.
assessment.maturity: Its clinical impact and the broader paradigm of biomarker-directed oncology are long established.
uncertainties: The supplied evidence does not resolve the full distribution of credit among discovery, diagnostic, and clinical-development contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetically engineered CAR-T cells created a powerful new therapeutic modality for otherwise difficult cancers.
assessment.attribution: The three listed scientists cover central conceptual and translational strands of adoptive engineered-cell therapy.
assessment.maturity: Clinical efficacy is established, although the modality continues to evolve.
uncertainties: Durability, toxicity, access, and effectiveness beyond selected hematologic cancers remain important limitations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition transformed chronic myeloid leukemia and provided a defining demonstration of molecularly targeted cancer treatment.
assessment.attribution: The proposed laureates reflect drug discovery and clinical translation, though upstream biological discoveries also matter.
assessment.maturity: Long-term clinical use offers unusually strong confirmation of benefit and of the underlying therapeutic principle.
uncertainties: Attribution may need to distinguish the BCR-ABL discovery itself from development and validation of its inhibition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Long-term potentiation supplied an influential experimental account of activity-dependent synaptic change relevant to learning and memory.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names represent discovery, characterization, and linkage of the phenomenon to memory; the four-person candidate list exceeds a three-laureate award.
assessment.maturity: The finding has remained central to neuroscience for decades and has been tested across many experimental settings.
uncertainties: Long-term potentiation is not a complete explanation of memory, and assigning a limited set of laureates is intrinsically difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: PCSK9 human genetics provided compelling target validation and enabled an important cholesterol-lowering therapeutic strategy.
assessment.attribution: The proposed laureates represent key genetic and mechanistic contributions, but the candidate contains several plausible claimants.
assessment.maturity: The causal pathway and therapeutic application are well substantiated in clinical medicine.
uncertainties: The supplied evidence does not permit fine-grained adjudication among the five credited contributors or later therapeutic developers.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: TNF blockade transformed treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and established a broadly consequential strategy for inflammatory disease.
assessment.attribution: The two named contributors form a focused and readily attributable partnership linking pathogenic mechanism to therapeutic testing.
assessment.maturity: The principle has extensive clinical confirmation across inflammatory disorders.
uncertainties: The candidate evidence does not specify how credit should be apportioned relative to other TNF biology and antibody-development contributors.
